pnpm.//: hoist-pattern[]=!@types/react in .npmrc keeps React 19's types out of the shared hoist directory, which is what stops them leaking into the mobile type-check (AD-01). The cost is that a third-party package whose own .d.ts does `import * as React from "react"` has nowhere to resolve React's types from, so React.PureComponent degrades to an error and surfaces as "cannot be used as a JSX component" at the call site, a long way from the cause. Declaring the types dependency the package should have had puts a copy inside its own node_modules. Prefer this over re-hoisting, which fixes one package and re-breaks every app.
